newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe stockbroker joins HSBC banking group.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe stockbroker joins HSBC banking group.

text.p: Zimbabwe stockbroking and portfolio management company Quincor has entered into a joint venture with international stockbrokers HSBC James Capel, the firm said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said the joint venture would provide the Zimbabwean company -- to be called Quincor James Capel -- with an opportunity to strengthen the quality and depth of its services.

"We believe this joint venture provides a unique opportunity to strengthen the quality and depth of the services we provide to our customers in Zimbabwe. It will also give them an unmatched global perspective," Quincor said.
Quincor was established in 1991, focusing on the money market. It started trading in equities in 1993 and also undertakes analysis and research.

HSBC James Capel is part of the HSBC group, one of the world's largest banking and financial services organisations, with over 3,400 offices in 75 countries. In southern Africa, these include Namibia, Mozambique, Zambia, Angola and South Africa.
